_source: Oh My Pi (can1357/oh-my-pi) tag v18.12.6: the tool_call event {type, toolName, toolCallId, input} (packages/coding-agent/src/extensibility/extensions/types.ts:1331-1339) for the built-in ask tool, whose arguments are {questions: [{id, question, header?, options: [{label, description?, preview?}], multi?, recommended?}]} (packages/coding-agent/src/tools/ask.ts:60-83). A handler returns {block, reason}, the reason going to the model as the tool's error (shared-events.ts:331-335); one past extensionHandlers.toolCallTimeoutMs (30 s by default) blocks the tool. Values are synthetic.
